info.title: Octo Fleet Public API
info.description:
Stable Fleet API using product vocabulary: task, expert, expert team, and
execution. Legacy internal issue, agent, and squad routes remain separate.

tags.name: tasks
tags.description: Task lifecycle, collaboration, and execution operations.

get.description: Returns one workspace-scoped page of tasks.

post.description: Creates a task in the authenticated workspace.

get.description: Searches tasks using public task and assignee vocabulary.
Returns task groups using the requested grouping filters.
Aggregates child-task progress for the requested parents.
Returns one page of child tasks grouped by parent selection.

post.description: Creates and dispatches a task to exactly one expert or expert team.

get.description: Returns the task identified within the current workspace.

patch.description: Applies the supplied mutable task fields.

delete.description: Deletes the task and returns an empty data object.

get.description: Returns one page of comments for the task.

post.description: Adds a comment to the task as the authenticated principal.
Resolves mentions and automation triggers without creating a comment.

get.description: Returns one chronological page of task activity.
Returns one page of principals subscribed to the task.

post.description: Subscribes the authenticated principal or supplied actor target.
Removes the authenticated principal or supplied actor target.

get.description: Returns one page of executions created for the task.
Returns one page of non-terminal executions for the task.

post.description: Queues a replacement execution from the selected prior execution.
Requests cancellation of one execution belonging to the task.

get.description: Returns aggregated execution resource usage for the task.

post.description: Adds the authenticated principal reaction to the task.

delete.description: Removes the authenticated principal reaction from the task.

get.description: Returns one page of files attached to the task.
Returns one page of immediate child tasks.
Returns one page of labels attached to the task.

post.description: Attaches one existing workspace label to the task.

delete.description: Removes one label association and returns the remaining labels.

get.description: Returns the task metadata map without rewriting opaque values.

put.description: Creates or replaces one opaque task metadata value.

delete.description: Deletes one metadata key and returns the remaining metadata.

get.description: Returns one page of pull requests linked to the task.
Returns one page of messages produced by the execution.

post.description: Requests cancellation of the selected execution.

get.description: Returns one page of experts in the current workspace.

post.description: Creates an expert using public expert vocabulary.
Instantiates an expert from the selected template.

get.description: Returns one expert from the current workspace.

patch.description: Applies supplied mutable expert configuration fields.

post.description: Marks the expert unavailable for new task assignment.
Restores an archived expert for future assignments.
Requests cancellation of active executions owned by the expert.

get.description: Returns one page of executions assigned to the expert.
Returns one page of skills assigned to the expert.

put.description: Replaces the complete expert skill assignment set.

post.description: Adds skills without removing existing expert assignments.

get.description: Returns the expert custom runtime environment variables.

put.description: Replaces the expert custom runtime environment variables.

get.description: Returns one page of templates available to the workspace.
Returns one expert template by stable template identifier.
Returns one page of expert teams in the workspace.

post.description: Creates an expert team and assigns its leader.

get.description: Returns one expert team from the current workspace.

delete.description: Deletes the expert team and returns an empty data object.

get.description: Returns one page of expert-team members.

post.description: Adds one expert or nested expert team as a member.

delete.description: Removes one supplied member from the expert team.

patch.description: Changes one member role without replacing membership.

get.description: Returns current workload status for all team members.

bearer_auth.description: Loop credential or supported long-lived Octo server credential.

octo_session.name: Token
octo_session.description: Octo session token accepted directly by Fleet.

MetadataID.name: metadata_id
MetadataID.description: Metadata key encoded as a path identifier.

Empty.description: Operation completed with no resource payload.

ValidationError.description: VALIDATION_ERROR — request fields or pagination are invalid.

Unauthorized.description: AUTH_REQUIRED — credentials are absent or invalid.

Forbidden.description: FORBIDDEN — principal lacks the required action.

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND — requested workspace resource does not exist.

RateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED — request rate exceeded the configured limit.

InternalError.description: INTERNAL_ERROR — Fleet could not complete the operation.
